transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me a little bit about what has been bothering you and what brings you in to see me today?
I’ve just been feeling really down and depressed for a long time now. Honestly, I've felt this constant sadness and emptiness for about two years, and it just hasn't gotten any better.

During these past two years, have there been any periods of a few weeks or longer where your mood was significantly worse than it currently is, or has the intensity of your sadness remained relatively stable throughout this entire time?

It's hard to remember specific weeks or if it fluctuated much over such a long time. For the most part, it just feels like a constant, ongoing cloud of sadness has been hanging over me for the entire two years. It doesn't really seem to lift or change.
During these two years, have there been any periods of two months or longer where you felt completely free of these symptoms and felt like your usual self?

No, I haven't had any breaks like that at all. Over the last two years, I don't think I've gone even a couple of weeks without feeling this way, let alone two months. It has just been completely constant.
Besides the constant sadness, have you been experiencing other symptoms such as changes in your appetite, sleep patterns, energy levels, or difficulty concentrating?

My sleep has been awful; I really struggle to fall asleep, wake up constantly during the night, and wake up way too early. Even when I sleep for a long time, I have terrible nightmares and still feel completely exhausted and unrefreshed. I haven't really noticed any big changes in my appetite or concentration, though.
During this two-year period, have you lost interest or pleasure in the activities, hobbies, or social interactions that you used to enjoy?
I haven't really noticed a loss of interest or pleasure in my activities. I'm not quite sure about that specific symptom, to be honest.
Over the past two years, have you frequently felt down on yourself, experienced feelings of inadequacy, or felt like you were a failure?

Yes, I've felt that way constantly for the past two years. I am always criticizing myself and feeling completely inferior to everyone else. I just feel like a failure who can't do anything right and I have no confidence in myself.
Have you frequently felt a sense of hopelessness or felt that things would never get better during these past two years?

I'm not really sure if I would call it hopelessness, and I haven't really thought about it in those exact terms. It's more that I've just had this constant, persistent low mood for the last two years and it's hard to imagine feeling any different.
Beyond the sleep issues you mentioned, would you say you have felt a persistent lack of energy or chronic fatigue for most of the day, nearly every day, for these past two years?
I wouldn't say I feel a persistent physical lack of energy or chronic fatigue throughout the day. It is more that my sleep just never feels refreshing, so I always wake up feeling tired.
Has this persistent sadness and the feeling of being a failure caused you significant distress or difficulty in your daily functioning, such as at work, school, or in your personal relationships?
I'm not quite sure, to be honest. I haven't really thought about how much it has affected my work or relationships specifically. I just try to get through each day.
While you mentioned earlier that you hadn't noticed big changes, have you found yourself either eating significantly more or significantly less than usual over these past two years?
No, I really haven't noticed any significant changes in my eating habits or appetite over the past two years. My eating has stayed pretty much the same as it always has been.
